The vertical pillars supporting the roof show slight inconsistency in thickness and alignment with the perspective lines of the shelter above, appearing slightly warped.
The front grille/bumper area lacks clear definition or logical assembly; it appears as a smooth, featureless white mass rather than distinct plastic or metal parts.
